purpose: Audio asset research and original review previews, not a production runtime manifest or app implementation.
soundDirection: Restrained, warm wood/glass/air gestures for Seafoam Forest. Reveal carries the most presence; frequent page and close cues stay brief. No music bed, real-world alarm, animal imitation, navigation sound or borrowed brand motif.
deliveryFormat: 48 kHz, 16-bit, mono, uncompressed signed little-endian PCM in RIFF/WAVE. Non-looping local files.
formatCaveat: Supported format choice, not proof of compatibility or intelligibility in the app. Viro version and actual Galaxy A53 playback must be checked by the implementing agent.

cueDirection.name: reveal
cueDirection.label: Exhibit reveal
cueDirection.intent: Soft layered bloom; the strongest cue in this set.
cueDirection.trigger: After an exhibit reveal succeeds. If ready speech is playing, suppress this effect rather than overlap or replay it late.

cueDirection.name: panel_open
cueDirection.label: Panel open
cueDirection.trigger: After a different panel successfully opens; not on a disabled tap or repeated tap on the same panel.

cueDirection.name: page_turn
cueDirection.label: Page turn
cueDirection.intent: A light paper-grain flick, deliberately brief.
cueDirection.trigger: After a valid page change; coalesce rapid changes and discard stale effects, with no sound for a rejected/end-of-book action.

cueDirection.name: panel_close
cueDirection.label: Panel close
cueDirection.trigger: After a panel actually closes; do not play during interruption or scene teardown.

cueDirection.name: view_switch
cueDirection.label: View switch
cueDirection.intent: A paired airy handoff distinct from the reveal.
cueDirection.trigger: Only for the committed incoming view after a successful handoff, not a stale/cancelled transition. Reduced motion must not delay the state change for audio.

voice.readinessRule: Speak the selected localized ready line once per intentionally opened AR session, after the exhibit is loaded and tracking is normal. Camera tracking is not proof of arrival, admission, a detected surface, or safe surroundings.
voice.productionBrief: Approved scripts. Generate three properly licensed EN/JA/KO recordings from voice-generation-brief.md; no recordings are yet bundled.
voice.missingClipPolicy: Remain silent. Do not synthesize or fetch speech at runtime, substitute another language, or block the UI. Text remains available.

playbackHandoff.rule: Voice and Effects controls remain independent; the same localized visible and accessible status must work with both off.
Give startup speech priority inside the app. Drop competing effects; do not queue stale one-shots or replay them after speech.
Request and respect Android audio focus. On denial, interruption, backgrounding or scene exit, cancel and reset pending playback. Do not resume a fragment after a call or screen lock.
Treat mute, pause and cancel/reset as distinct behavior. Verify the existing Viro player's lifecycle and one-shot completion handling against the installed version.
Use local, non-looping assets. A missing/failed clip is silent and must not block a successful interaction. Never make sound necessary to understand an action.
The unlock modal has no audio dependency. These effects are AR exhibit feedback, not eligibility confirmation, a direction to walk, or an environmental-safety cue.

preferenceMatrix.expected: No app audio; complete localized visible and accessible feedback.
Approved localized ready speech only; absent speech remains silent.
Approved effects only; no speech or fallback voice.
Ready speech has priority; competing effects are skipped, later successful actions may play effects.

reviewChecklist: Project owner approves the five cue identities and perceived levels; repeat paging many times to check fatigue.
Native EN/JA/KO listeners approve wording, pronunciation, tone and actual recorded takes.
Galaxy A53 in the actual build: offline playback, user-selected speaker/headphone volume and realistic ambient noise.
Calls, audio-focus denial/loss, headset disconnection, lock/unlock, background/return and scene exit: no unexpected speaker blast or stale replay.
All four Voice/Effects combinations; no settings coupling and no sound-only information.
Rapid taps, cancelled swaps, reduced motion, missing/broken clips and TalkBack.
Confirm asset distribution terms and retain release approval; procedural provenance does not certify exclusivity.
verificationLimits: Digital file structure, levels and checksums can be measured; listening quality and phone-speaker performance have not been signed off.
No human speech recordings were generated or obtained. The three voice lines are owner-approved scripts awaiting recordings.
No app repository, audio player or production manifest has been changed.
Peak and RMS values are digital measurements, not sound-pressure measurements or guarantees of safe/adequate outdoor loudness.
provenance: New procedural synthesis from sine functions, seeded noise, envelopes and filters. No samples, stock recordings, speech, music recordings, or model voices used.
distributionNotes: No third-party sample library or performance clearance is required by these inputs; no exclusivity or legal clearance is asserted. Project owner to approve release and applicable terms.

cues.name: reveal
cues.procedure: Layered, offset 349/523/698 Hz softly excited resonances, with airy grain.
cues.label: Exhibit reveal
cues.intent: Soft layered bloom; the strongest cue in this set.
cues.trigger: After an exhibit reveal succeeds. If ready speech is playing, suppress this effect rather than overlap or replay it late.

cues.name: panel_open
cues.procedure: Short upward-curving wood tap, with an offset higher glass resonance.
cues.label: Panel open
cues.trigger: After a different panel successfully opens; not on a disabled tap or repeated tap on the same panel.

cues.name: page_turn
cues.procedure: Two unequal filtered paper-grain gestures with a short damped wooden edge.
cues.label: Page turn
cues.intent: A light paper-grain flick, deliberately brief.
cues.trigger: After a valid page change; coalesce rapid changes and discard stale effects, with no sound for a rejected/end-of-book action.

cues.name: panel_close
cues.procedure: Downward-pitched damped body with short soft felt contact.
cues.label: Panel close
cues.trigger: After a panel actually closes; do not play during interruption or scene teardown.

cues.name: view_switch
cues.procedure: Two overlapping filtered-air gestures change bands, with a hint of resonance.
cues.label: View switch
cues.intent: A paired airy handoff distinct from the reveal.
cues.trigger: Only for the committed incoming view after a successful handoff, not a stale/cancelled transition. Reduced motion must not delay the state change for audio.
